_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.0 part 33: read by tools/hoenn/living_dex.py.
extra_sources: sources the parser can't see. Each names a file and a text it must contain, so a stale entry fails.
waits_for: the source comes from another open PR; until it merges the species is reported as pending, not as an error.
one_of_a_kind: species (and their family) that may only come from the listed sources (prefixes of the tool's source names).
unreachable_script_files: script files HnS includes but can never run (none so far).
